scheme_name: Financial Incentives To Mothers Who Deliver A Girl Child (Mamta)
other_conditions: Mother must have delivered a live Girl Child in a registered medical institution (maximum of 2 deliveries)
Applicant must be a resident of Goa for at least three years, or be married to a resident of Goa
Application must be submitted within 45 days of the delivery
benefits_summary: One-time cash incentive of ₹10,000 (or the remaining ₹5,000 for beneficiaries who have already received the first ₹5,000 installment)
